name: PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk engages in the provision of banking products and services in Indonesia. It operates through Retail Funding, Loan and Export Import, and Treasury segments. The company offers saving, time, and demand deposits; working capital, investment, vehicle, current account, import/export, consumer, and housing loans; and banknotes. It provides business savings products; Giro products; business loan solutions, such as working capital, overdraft, demand, and other credit facilities; employee benefit program; cash management; trade finance solutions; foreign exchange transaction options; and internet banking services.
